invaded_niche['n.total'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['n.total'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['elevation'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['elevation'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['urban.2009.500m'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['urban.2009.500m'], errors='coerce')

# Drop the 'habitat' column
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.drop(columns=['habitat'])

# Define the formula for the regression model
formula = 'n_gard ~ n_total + elevation + urban_2009_500m'

# Fit the regression model
model = ols(formula, data=invaded_niche).fit()

# Print the summary of the regression model
model.summary()

import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t')

# Convert relevant columns to numeric types
invaded_niche['n.gard'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['n.gard'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['n.total'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['n.total'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['elevation'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['elevation'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['urban.2009.500m'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['urban.2009.500m'], errors='coerce')

# Drop the 'habitat' column
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.drop(columns=['habitat'])

# Prepare the data for regression
X = invaded_niche[['n_total', 'elevation', 'urban_2009_500m']]
y = invaded_niche['n_gard']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the regression model
model.summary()
